protocol.status: exploratory follow-up defined before calculating these endpoints; not preregistered research
protocol.target: complete 100x2 phase-normalized target-motion-onset to last-tracker-sample paths; original translations retained; no recropping, filtering or dynamic time warping
protocol.primary_geometry: Euclidean distance after flattening ordered paths and dividing by sqrt(200), equivalent to root mean coordinate squared difference; common tracker units retained
protocol.sensitivity_geometry: divide each axis by its training RMS deviation from the training mean path, shared across 100 points; then divide flattened vector by sqrt(200)
protocol.energy: 2 mean cross Euclidean distance minus within-recorded and within-generated means, including diagonal zeros; not square-rooted
protocol.mmd2: unbiased RBF MMD squared, within-sample diagonals excluded; gamma=1/median positive training squared distance among up to 512 deterministic training trials
protocol.diagnostics: biased MMD squared, mean-path RMSE, all-pairs MSE and generated/recorded total sample-variance ratio; none is a substitute for the primary distribution endpoints
protocol.spline_sampling: one historical deterministic fit and frozen sampling realization per fold/dimension
protocol.sampling: exact historical context centroid, covariance, query-condition mixture and RNG; each model generation must reproduce its existing feature scores
protocol.references: resample 120 own context trajectories with replacement, using three stable SHA-derived seeds; repeat the context mean path 120 times as a collapse diagnostic. Neither is a compact model or population null reference.
protocol.aggregation: average seeds within participant then give all 28 participants equal weight; record fold and per-seed results
protocol.inference: 80 exploratory paired two-sided Pratt Wilcoxon comparisons, 10 pairs among 5 model families x 2 dimensions x 2 distribution endpoints x 2 geometries; BH and Holm over all 80 together. Condition Ridge is reused at both dimensions. No tests on diagnostic references.
protocol.limits: no physical-time fidelity claim; same-session context/query; overlapping training folds; inherited char-sum RNG collisions; no independent validation of model selection; finite-sample distances are not accuracy percentages
